answer: Each epoch this economy holds an unannounced roll call. At a random minute every voting key gets its own prism question, a reasoning task derived from that key and a fresh beacon, and must reply within 90 seconds; three random peers check the replies. A clean reply lifts the key one terrace of voting weight, capped at five; a missed or copied reply drops it to the lowest terrace and forfeits its 40-unit copper deposit. The binder is concurrency: an operator with 1,000 keys must answer 1,000 distinct live tasks at once, so compute cost grows per clone. Limit: rented burst capacity.
